description:
Change, read or remove an existing SimplifyQA suite. Pick ONE `action`:
- action:"get" — needs `suiteId`. READS the suite's Settings panel: execution type and autoReExecCount / autoDefectLog / autoReExecTriggerOn / newBrowserSession / terminateOnFailure / container limits. Use it to CONFIRM a setting after saving (also after a client restart — the settings live in the backend).
- action:"update" — needs `suiteId` and at least one of `name`, `description`, `executionType` (the suite's Execution Type menu: "local", "remote", "cloud" or "stack"), `settings` (autoDefectLog, autoReExecCount, autoReExecTriggerOn, newBrowserSession, terminateOnFailure, minimumContainerCount, maximumContainerCount).
- action:"delete" — needs `suiteId`. TWO-STEP: call without `confirm` to PREVIEW (nothing is deleted), show it to the user, and call again with `confirm:true` ONLY after the user explicitly says to delete. A suite still used by a schedule, pipeline, execution plan or test plan is refused.
- action:"stack_setup" — needs `suiteId` and `stacks` (how many) or `stackConfigs`. Saves the suite's STACK setup (the Stack canvas behind Execution Type → Stack). Saves the Stack Setup (what the Stack canvas saves). Give `stacks` (a number: that many alike, test cases spread round-robin) OR `stackConfigs` (one entry per stack: its platform local / remote / cloud, browser, remote machine and, if the user says which, its test cases). `append:true` ADDS stacks to the saved setup instead of replacing it (existing stacks keep their platform; with no test cases named, all are re-spread over old + new). Every stack needs at least one test case, a REMOTE stack needs a machine, and CLOUD needs a cloud machine configured for the project. Run it afterwards with mode:"stack". `stackMode` "cloud" (default) or "local" and `browser` are the defaults for stacks that do not say.
AUTO DEFECT LOGGING for the suite = action:"update" with settings:{ autoDefectLog:true } (failed steps then log a defect automatically). It needs the project's admin "Auto Defect Logging" switch on; if it is off the call is refused with that instruction — tell the user to ask an admin to enable it, then retry.
Add/remove member test cases with suite_add_testcases / suite_remove_testcases; create with suite_create.

action.description: What to do with the suite.

append.description: action "stack_setup": add the stack(s) to the saved setup instead of replacing it.

browser.description: action "stack_setup": browser for WEB test cases (default chrome).

confirm.description: action "delete": true on the SECOND call, only after the user explicitly said to delete.

executionType.description: action "update": the suite's Execution Type (the UI menu) — "stack" selects Stack execution. Sent as lastSelectedExecutionType.

stackConfigs.description: stack_setup: describe each stack, in order — one entry per stack (this sets the number of stacks; leave `stacks` out or make it match). E.g. [{ mode:"local" }, { mode:"cloud" }, { mode:"remote", agentId:"build-box-2" }].

agentId.description: REMOTE stacks only, required: the machine to run on — its id or machine name (see local_agents / remote_agents).

browser.description: Browser for the WEB test cases on this stack. LOCAL / REMOTE stacks: chrome, firefox, edge, safari (and their headless / incognito variants). A CLOUD stack offers ONLY Chrome Headless, Firefox Headless or Edge Headless — pass chrome / firefox / edge and it is that headless one; any other value is refused with those three. Default chrome (its headless one on a cloud stack).

mode.description: Where THIS stack runs (default: stackMode, else cloud).

testCases.description: Test cases (TC-39 or id) to put on THIS stack. Name them for every stack, or for none (then they are spread evenly).

stackMode.description: action "stack_setup": where the stacks run (default cloud).

stacks.description: action "stack_setup": number of stacks — with append:true, how many to ADD. Omit when stackConfigs lists them.

suiteId.description: Suite id or code (SU-12). Needed by every action.

name: suite_manage
title: Update or delete a suite (SimplifyQA)
